description: This is a Python source file implementing a custom pytest plugin for sharding test collection across multiple shards. It defines functions and a class to add command-line options for shard configuration, filter test items based on hashing, and report shard testing details.

classes.name: PytestShardPlugin
classes.description: A class implementing pytest hooks for sharding test collection, including methods for reporting, filtering, and modifying test items based on shard configuration.

methods.name: pytest_addoptions(parser: Parser)
methods.description: Adds command-line options '--shard-id', '--num-shards', and '--print-items' to configure test sharding.

methods.name: PytestShardPlugin.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with pytest configuration.

methods.name: PytestShardPlugin.pytest_report_collectionfinish
methods.description: Generates a report message after test collection finishes, indicating how many items are tested in the current shard, optionally listing item identifiers.

methods.name: PytestShardPlugin.sha256hash
methods.description: Computes a sha256 hash of a string and returns it as an integer.

methods.name: PytestShardPlugin.filter_items_by_shard
methods.description: Filters collected test items to include only those assigned to the specified shard based on hash value.

methods.name: PytestShardPlugin.pytest_collection_modifyitems
methods.description: Modifies the collected test items to only include those appropriate for the current shard, raising an error for invalid shard IDs.

methods.name: filter_items_by_shard(self, items, shard_id: int, num_shards: int)

ctags.name: filter_items_by_shard
ctags.pattern: /^    def filter_items_by_shard(self, items, shard_id: int, num_shards: int):$/
